notes.problem: Flat framed rectangle in a void; the eight a thin strip; dead lower quarter.
notes.fix: Bleed the field off three edges; lower the rake so only the eight cast long.

notes.problem: Straight-on flat grid in the grey middle; the eight a sliver at 432 px.
notes.fix: High three quarter view, one flood pooled on the eight, far rows to black.

notes.problem: Straight-on 860 grey cells read as a flat chart; the eight don't read as height.
notes.fix: Low three quarter under a hard key so the eight throw long shadows; field tops toward black.

notes.problem: Straight-on plan, carrier tight under the dek.
notes.fix: Drop the carrier 120 px, bleed it off the bottom, rake lower.

notes.problem: Straight-on carrier jammed under the dek on a lifted charcoal field.
notes.fix: Drop the carrier 120 px, navy black field, turn the camera 20 to 30 degrees.

notes.problem: Straight-on plate tight under the dek reads as a diagram.
notes.fix: Carrier 120 px clear of the dek, 30 degree three quarter view.

notes.problem: Neck renders as a dark gap breaking the outer leaflet.
notes.fix: Continuous hourglass head rows, no carrier showing between them.

notes.problem: Subject in the lower 45 percent; necks and SNAREs small.
notes.fix: Push in 1.4x on the neck; crop the arc off the top and sides.

notes.problem: Neck ambiguous at feed size; charcoal mid band; SNAREs tiny.
notes.fix: Crop in on the neck so membranes and SNAREs fill a third; warm side light; near black ground.

notes.problem: Broad mid-grey pool; empty background frames contradict frame 9.
notes.fix: Tighten the flood; remove or darken the background frames.

notes.problem: Pale mid-grey floor, a hard-edged lighter rectangle on it, rod-cage racks, cables under the footer.
notes.fix: Remove the floor rectangle, pull the flood tight, end the cables before the footer.

notes.problem: Pale lit floor takes more of the frame than the wire frame.
notes.fix: Tighten the pool to the frame and its tray, let the floor fall to black, push in.

notes.problem: Board a mid-grey field of white rectangles reads as placeholder.
notes.fix: Near-black graphite with fine copper traces, populated DIMM slots.

notes.problem: Same charcoal relief, SNAREs small; labels do the explaining.
notes.fix: Raking side light, SNARE coils cast onto the bilayer, darker core stripes.

notes.problem: The same hard-edged floor rectangle; skeletal rod frame.
notes.fix: Delete the floor artifact; solid side panels.
